name: devcheck_nodev@alphabeta
requires: an epoch whose snapshot has the devcards.buy tunable (run_queue.py --bump-code --areas other); until then the queue shows the row BLOCKED
notes: docs/SCRUTINY.md Q22, check 1 (due diligence; a measurement reported next to the registered results, it never changes them): our default bot with development-card purchases OFF (devcards.buy=off: BUY_DEV removed from our bot's own choices; opponent model unchanged) vs 3x Catanatron's AlphaBeta, paired seed by seed against the default arm (same spec, same seeds), 1,000 seeds on a fresh block (ablate seeds 400000-400999). Reading: ESTIMATE delta +- 1.96 se = the part of our 1v3 win rate vs AlphaBeta that comes from buying development cards (negative = the purchases help us); report the default arm's win rate next to proof T2 (54.5 %, 218/400). Tier smoke = outside every Holm family. Sanity readout: mech dev_bought must be 0.0 for the candidate (default ~6 a game; proof: 6.2). crn auto = --crn dice once the CRN pilot passed. Cost ~2,000 AlphaBeta games (~12.8 CPU-h at the queue's 23 s prior); exclusive like the other AlphaBeta rows.

name: devcheck_fixvp_t2_g000-040
requires: an epoch whose snapshot has the alphabeta_fixvp preset (scripts/bench_catanatron.py PRESETS, catanbot/bench/patched_alphabeta.py; --bump-code)
notes: docs/SCRUTINY.md Q22, check 2 (due diligence, reported next to proof T2 = 54.5 %, never changing it): our default bot vs 3x alphabeta_fixvp = OUR patch of Catanatron's AlphaBetaPlayer (not Catanatron's player: it counts its own hidden VP cards with ACTUAL_VICTORY_POINTS and scores a won / lost finished game +/- 1e16; otherwise catanatron's defaults: depth 2, base weights, no pruning). Exactly T2's protocol (scripts/run_proof.sh: bench 1v3, seat g % 4, spec search:depth=1,beam=4,expand=8,evaluator=heuristic, --seed 900001, games 0-399, trades off, hash seed 0, --rerun-crashes) with the opponent swapped, so each game is paired by seed with T2's game of the same index. Chunk 1 of 10 (games 0-39, T2's chunk size 40), about 0.3 CPU-h.

name: devcheck_fixvp_t2_replay
notes: Q22 check 2, closing step: replay --check of all 400 logged games (exit 0 = PASS). The result is read by hand from the ten chunk JSONs: win rate = wins / 400 with its Wilson 95 % interval, next to T2's 54.5 % (218/400), plus the paired comparison with T2 by game index (discordant games, exact McNemar), and the patched AlphaBeta's development cards bought per game (T2: 0.15 per AlphaBeta). Caveat: T2 was played by the proof's code; if the default bot has changed since the proof, a stock alphabeta control on the same 400 seeds separates the patch's effect from our own changes.
